title: Reconcile local checkout onto rebuilt origin history before cutting any new branch
description:
The public repository was deleted and rebuilt on fresh history on 2026-09-10 under OPAG-70: origin HEAD, dev and main are all at e3d758679d46cd0e80cd59432b059bf0a4f83e88 ("chore: fresh history for the public repository"). This local checkout at /Volumes/external/repos/lore-cli is still on the PRE-PURGE history — local dev sits at 90f94bf, which is not an ancestor of e3d7586.

A branch cut from the stale local dev would carry the pre-purge history into a PR and re-expose it through refs/pull/N/head — exactly what deleting and rebuilding the repository was meant to remove. Reconciliation is therefore a precondition for the next piece of work in this repo, not a someday cleanup.

The fix is a hard reset of local dev and main onto origin, which is destructive and needs the user's direct approval — the orchestrator's instruction to sequence it is not that approval. Ask with AskUserQuestion before running it.

Context: annotated tag v0.6.0 was re-created on e3d7586 (tag object 800873f) and pushed on 2026-09-10, restoring opum-lore marketplace federation; verified at the ref (skills tree 24277e9a, SKILL.md blob feda4a6b, plugin.json opum-lore 0.6.0, author.name "Opum AI"). That work is complete and independently verified by opum-agent and opum-marketplace.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Local dev and main both point at origin's current commit, with no divergence reported against origin
The user explicitly approved the hard reset beforehand via AskUserQuestion — an orchestrator instruction does not substitute
No branch was cut from the pre-purge history in the meantime, and no PR exists carrying pre-purge commits
The old head 90f94bf is no longer reachable from any local branch

finalSummary:
Reconciled 2026-09-10 with the user's direct approval via AskUserQuestion.

Verified before acting, so the cost of the reset was known rather than assumed: local dev's tree and origin's tree were the SAME object (92265cf07dec1855a8c7f2e9f799275d70682c22), so the reset discarded history only and zero file content. git cherry against old dev showed 8 of 9 local branches had patch-equivalents already landed as squash merges; the 1 genuinely unlanded change (the widened LCLI-463 record from chore/LCLI-463-widen-scope @ 5bcc301) was archived to /Volumes/external/archive/lore-cli/pre-purge-unlanded-work/ with a restore note BEFORE the reset, and is tracked for re-application.

Actions: git reset --hard origin/dev; git branch -f main origin/main; deleted all 9 pre-purge branches.

Result, all 4 acceptance criteria met: dev and main both at e3d758679 tracking origin with no divergence; the user approved beforehand; no branch was cut from the pre-purge history and no PR carries pre-purge commits; git branch --contains 90f94bf now returns nothing, so the old head is unreachable from any local branch. The purged content no longer sits behind ordinary refs on this machine, only in reflog, which expires. Untracked tracker records LCLI-468/469 survived the reset as expected.
